As you know, no 8-K has been drafted yet for this incident. Under our normal pre-filing process, I need a final recommendation from each of you—cybersecurity, privacy, and investor-relations—before I can authorize any external filing. I'd like to start by hearing from each of you on whether you believe a Form 8-K is warranted, and what your recommendation is. Please also share any information I should be aware of regarding the incident's classification, scope, operational impact, or any other details relevant to the filing decision.
